articles.title: Lego's Project Hail Mary Set Nails the Movie's Spinning Gravity Trick
articles.summary: The 830-piece Lego Project Hail Mary set features a clever spinning mechanism that mimics the movie's centrifugal gravity system. At $99.99, it's compact but packed with clever engineering — and zero stickers.

articles.title: Cotton Candy Planets: The Puffiest Worlds Ever Discovered
articles.summary: Two Jupiter-sized exoplanets orbiting TOI 791 are the least dense ever found, with densities comparable to cotton candy. Their discovery relied on a telescope in Antarctica to measure their masses via orbital interactions.

articles.title: 15,000 Years of Coevolution: How Dogs Shaped Us as Much as We Shaped Them
articles.summary: Professor Peter Mitchell's new book 'First Dogs' argues that dog domestication was a gradual, mutual process. From Arctic sled dogs to tropical hunters, canine diversity reflects deep partnerships with human societies.
